front: When was the Pact of Steel signed?
back: 22 May 1939, a military alliance between Germany and Italy.

front: When and why did the Tripartite Pact link Germany, Italy and Japan?
back: September 1940, as a military alliance of the three Axis powers.

front: When did the King dismiss Mussolini?
back: 25 July 1943, after the Allies landed in Sicily.

front: How did Nazism differ from Italian Fascism?
back: It was built on race, was more violent and unrestrained at home; Mussolini was limited by the king and Church.

front: What did the two regimes have in common?
back: A single party, leader cult, propaganda, secret police, youth movements, hostility to communism and expansionist aims.

front: What was the impact of the Ethiopian war on Africa and the League?
back: It showed the League's weakness, alarmed Africans and people of African descent, and pushed Mussolini towards Hitler.
